case_title: STUMPS, LEROY VS FORT, THOMAS M.

docket_entries.description: RENEWAL OF JUDGMENT ON CASE 709070 FILED BY PLAINTIFF STUMPS, LEROY AS TO DEFENDANT FORT, THOMAS M.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF STUMPS, LEROY RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT FORT, THOMAS M. $5,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $4,845.86 INTEREST, $26.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $9,871.86, $27.00-THE $13 ORIGINAL COST IS ADDED TO $14 FILING FEE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
THE COMPUTEER WILL NOT ACCEPT A PRINCIPAL OF MORE THAN $5000, SO THE ORIGINAL COST OF $13 IS ADDED TO THE FILING FEE OF $14 TO MAKE $27 THE NEW COST.
